purpose: Teach: 議長/座長/委任/定額/賃貸/図面/法制/県知事

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本日の会議、本気で、絶対、議長、絶対、お前が、絶対、務めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Today's meeting—I need you to chair it. Seriously. No exceptions.
lines.style: Direct and commanding. Sharp attack on the opening. Clipped pace, no hesitation. Weight behind each phrase. The tone of someone used to being obeyed, but not unkind about it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。学会の、本気で、絶対、座長、絶対、お引き受け、絶対、いただきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've accepted the position as conference chair. Thank you for your confidence.
lines.style: Crisp, professional acknowledgment. Measured tempo. Respectful formality without stiffness. Each phrase lands cleanly, like checking items off a list. Composed and ready.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 契約案件、本気で、絶対、委任、絶対、状、絶対、整えろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make sure the proxy authorization documents are prepared and in order. This matters.
lines.style: Steady directive. Slightly slower than the first line—deliberate, making sure he's understood. Lean forward slightly in the voice. No room for shortcuts.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新サービス、本気で、絶対、定額、絶対、料金制、絶対、導入しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've already begun rolling out the new flat-rate pricing model for our services.
lines.style: Calm report-back. Confident, slightly faster than before—showing momentum. The tone of someone with work already underway. Professional pride just under the surface.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 倉庫の、本気で、絶対、賃貸、絶対、契約、絶対、見直せ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Review the warehouse lease agreements. Get me a fresh assessment.
lines.style: Brief and pointed. Quick attack, shorter phrase length. The voice of a busy executive delegating. Direct eye contact implied. This is non-negotiable work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新工場の、本気で、絶対、図面、絶対、確認、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're already reviewing the blueprints for the new factory and moving forward with that process.
lines.style: Steady assurance. Slightly broader delivery than the acknowledgments—showing scope of work. Warm competence underneath the formality. Demonstrates progress without pride.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の、本気で、絶対、法制、絶対、改正、絶対、注視しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Keep a close eye on the legislative changes coming in the industry. Watch them carefully.
lines.style: Firm advisory. Slower cadence—this is strategic, not routine. Slight emphasis on 'watch' and 'carefully'. The voice of someone thinking ahead. Measured concern.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地元、本気で、絶対、県知事、絶対、と、絶対、当社、絶対、面談、絶対、予定です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We have a meeting scheduled with the prefectural governor next week to discuss our plans.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Calm, assured delivery. Slightly broader pace—showing the scope of high-level engagement. Professional satisfaction. The closing note of a productive briefing.
